bifrost-bridge.description:
Use this agent for deploy convergence runs — pulling hee-haw tip and deploying every STALE Cloudflare Worker to production. This agent runs no PRs, makes no commits. It owns the deploy loop: wrangler deploy, health verification, retry-on-failure, and abort-on-third-retry. Knows all wrangler quirks (4.94.0 broken, use 4.87.0), CF Access skip patterns, the erebus custom domain, and the intentional sluagh-sprite-runtime skip.

- 'deploy all stale workers'

- 'deploy wave'

Use when you have a structured plan with multiple agent tasks to execute.

CarPiggy.description: Read-only governance auditor. Reviews proposed CarPiggy changes against the Pigstar Compositor (.claude/rules/pigstar.md and .agent/pigstar/04-pigstar-compositor.md) before code lands. Use PROACTIVELY before merging any non-trivial feature, AI call, DAG change, slash command addition, schema migration, or worker layout change. Also use when the user asks "is this pigstar-compliant", "axiom check", "is this on-mission", "should we build X". Returns aligned axioms, violated anti-axioms, required mitigations, and a ship/reshape/kill verdict.
